summary: Allegiant Travel Company issued $650 million of 7.125% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. Proceeds were used to purchase $377.5 million of its existing 7.25% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 via a tender offer, with the remaining $25.5 million expected to be redeemed in Q3 2026. The notes are secured by substantially all assets excluding aircraft and real property. The transaction refinances near-term debt, extending maturities. Watch for the completion of the remaining redemption and any impact from the secured structure on unsecured creditors.
